description: Declarative map of system-prompt sections to their origin. Edit this file (not code) when pi's layout changes.
note: Section names and their order come from the live session transcript. A transcript patch with a null value means the section was removed.

preamble.detail: Role sentence. Overridden entirely when customPrompt/forceSystemPrompt is set.

tools.detail: Visible tools = selectedTools filtered to those with a non-empty toolSnippets entry.

rules.detail: toolGuidelines + promptGuidelines + two fixed rules; de-duplicated, order = selectedTools order.

project_context.detail: Each contributing file is listed inside the section as <project_instructions path="...">.

skills.detail: Built by formatSkillsForPrompt(); only name/description/location reach the prompt, not the body.

cwd.detail: Rendered with backslashes normalised to forward slashes.

runtimeInjections.detail: Appended to the rendered prompt string, NOT persisted as a transcript section. Rebuilt by scripts/lib/subagent-block.mjs, pinned to contract v3.0.1.
